topic: What margin allocation strategies ensure reliable entanglement distribution across fluctuating atmospheric fading channels with high photon loss?
consensus_response: To ensure reliable entanglement distribution, post-selection and entanglement distillation strategies can be employed to mitigate the effects of atmospheric fading. Post-selection allocates resources to high-transmission-coefficient windows, enhancing both entanglement and quantum key rates. Entanglement distillation reserves channel capacity for a minimum 50% entanglement generation rate (re) in the presence of unknown transmission coefficients. Temporal correlations can be leveraged to improve margin allocation strategies through informed resource allocation. Non-deterministic operations probabilistically increase entanglement, introducing uncertainty in reliable entanglement distribution.
reference_context: Satellite-based continuous-variable quantum communications suffer from high photon loss, with atmospheric fading channels introducing vacuum noise affecting entanglement distribution. Post-selection and entanglement distillation strategies can mitigate these effects, while temporal correlations can be leveraged to improve margin allocation.
